bio.text: Heidi Kuhn is the Democratic nominee for U.S. House in Tennessee's 8th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary.
She was Shelby County Criminal Court Clerk from 2018 until September 1, 2026, and lost the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary for Shelby County Mayor.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Mexico and a graduate degree from Christian Brothers University.
